channel.title: Abhishek Sharma — Writing
channel.description: Field notes on Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, on-device AI, and shipping reliable Android apps.

item.title: The portfolio you're reading: 9,000 points, one orbital instrument, no framework
item.description: How the hero on this site renders a dotted globe, precessing orbits and a tick bezel in a single WebGL canvas — with no build step and no animation library.

item.title: How we got to 99.2% crash-free users without a rewrite
item.description: Four months, three targeted fixes, and a system for keeping the number stable. Most Android crashes are lifetime bugs, not logic bugs.

item.title: Migrating a real module to Kotlin Multiplatform: start with the boring one
item.description: Skip the shared login demo. Move the module with zero Android imports, inject the platform, and get commonTest green on two targets.

item.title: Structured concurrency in Kotlin, explained by a bug I shipped
item.description: A screen that kept fetching after the user left taught me more about coroutine scopes than any tutorial. Here's the mental model and the three rules I follow now.

item.title: Seven Compose performance fixes that actually moved the needle
item.description: Jank on a mid-range phone forced me to stop guessing. These are the changes that showed up in Macrobenchmark — and the popular advice that didn't.

item.title: Shipping on-device AI without wrecking battery or trust
item.description: Everyone demos a model. Shipping one means budgeting watts, designing for 900ms of latency, and being honest about what leaves the device.
